schemas.mutable_self: PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; CREATE TABLE parent(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE child(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,parent_id TEXT REFERENCES parent(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED); CREATE TABLE seal(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,required_seal INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,sealed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,UNIQUE(id,sealed),FOREIGN KEY(id,required_seal) REFERENCES seal(id,sealed) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);
schemas.split_seal: PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; CREATE TABLE parent(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE child(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,parent_id TEXT REFERENCES parent(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED); CREATE TABLE seal(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,required_seal INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,sealed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,UNIQUE(id,sealed),FOREIGN KEY(id,required_seal) REFERENCES seal_commit(id,sealed) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED); CREATE TABLE seal_commit(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,sealed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(sealed=1),UNIQUE(id,sealed),FOREIGN KEY(id,sealed) REFERENCES seal(id,sealed) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);
